requirements: R1: Repair the Docker volume mount for backup scripts to prevent 'Is a directory' errors, and ensure the backend health check endpoint is reachable.

slices.title: Repair backup script volume mount and health check configuration
slices.jtbd: When implementing the runtime fix for this epic, I want to correctly mount the scripts directory and verify backend port binding, so that the application environment starts cleanly and passes all health checks.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the application's Docker compose configuration
When the environment is started
Then the backup script executes correctly without directory evaluation errors
And the backend container successfully responds to health check requests on the configured port
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% successful application launches and health check passes
